_readme: The ONE place for time budgets (seconds). target = what it SHOULD take; alarm = hard ceiling. The ci.* and ci-steps server/web/e2e-static rows and local.server-build were re-baselined on 2026-11-24 by the rule in .claude/docs/build-times.md (Rules; Astrolabe WHY 3): target = the median of at least ten green master runs rounded up to 30 s, alarm = the larger of 1.5 x target and 1.2 x the slowest run rounded up to a minute. The nightly e2e rows and the one-off local rows still carry their 1.0.0 figures (Astrolabe WHY 1) until ten runs exist. A breach or a rising trend is an investigation entry in .claude/docs/build-times.md, never a reason to raise a number here silently.

forkBalance.why: Ported from Flow: slow-tests --forks N warns when the suite span exceeds sum/N x (1 + maxExcessRatio) + minExcessSeconds; an even deal leaves a few seconds of straggler (the last class of one fork), an idle or unbalanced fork leaves tens of percent

changes.why: Kept at 15 s / 30 s on 2026-11-24 (WHY 3): the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a), median 9 s, range 4-15 s; the rule would loosen it to 30 s / 60 s, and it was never breached (it is one checkout + one git diff)

server-tests.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): the test span (earliest class start to latest end, the Test time report step) of the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a): median 6m36s, range 5m47s-10m13s, at two forks; the EPYC 7763 runners took 9m22s and 10m13s, the Xeon 8573C one 8m32s, the Xeon 6975P ones 5m47s-6m29s

server.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a), median 9m51s, range 9m04s-14m36s; by runner: Xeon 6975P 5 runs 9m04s-10m02s, EPYC 9V45 and 9V74 9m39s and 10m37s, Xeon 8573C 12m34s, EPYC 7763 13m28s and 14m36s; compile + detekt + tests (two forks) + Kover on 4 vCPU

gradle-vulnerability-scan.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a), median 52 s, range 38-80 s: the rule gives the figures it had (60 s / 120 s); 50 s of it is the settings-plugin audit under --no-daemon

web.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a), median 3m10s, range 3m03s-4m29s; Xeon 6975P 5 runs 3m03s-3m11s, EPYC 9V45 and 9V74 3m09s and 3m25s, EPYC 7763 2 runs 4m28s-4m29s, Xeon 8573C 4m00s; vitest is CPU-bound on the runner (WHY 3 evidence 2)

e2e-static.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a), median 70 s, range 67-87 s; one more run took 6m06s because its checkout step stalled for 300 s (a fetch, not the job; 66 s net), so that run counts as 66 s in the slowest figure

images.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a), median 3m07s, range 2m47s-3m41s; EPYC 7763 2 runs 3m38s and 3m41s, the rest 2m47s-3m21s: a plain docker compose build + the Trivy image scan

k8s-static.why: Kept at 20 s / 45 s on 2026-11-24 (WHY 3): the last ten green master ci runs on the final workflow (#280-#287, #289 on its re-run, #290: 260aca8..06fb28a), median 10.5 s, range 6-16 s; the rule would loosen it to 30 s / 60 s, and it was never breached (one checkout + kubeconform + validating the manifests)

e2e.why: Unchanged since 2026-11-05 (WHY 1; WHY 3 left it): only 7 green nightlies exist on the final workflow (2026-11-16..23: median 12m31s, range 10m22s-16m49s, over the 8m / 15m row), so it waits for ten (build-times.md WHY 3 outcome)

ci-steps._readme: Per-step budgets, keyed '<job>/<step name>' exactly as the workflow names the step; ci-times.mjs --steps <job> shows them beside each step's time. Same rules as above: a breach is a WHY entry, never a silent raise.

e2e/Install e2e deps.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 31 s in one run (6953b44): npm ci of the e2e workspace with the npm cache

e2e/Install Playwright browser.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 31 s in one run (6953b44): install-deps (apt) with the browser cached; slower on a cold cache when chromium is downloaded

e2e/Build images.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 2m40s in one run (6953b44), 2m45s in the images job at abed03f: a plain docker compose build of the app image, no layer cache

e2e/Start the stack.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 16 s in one run (6953b44): postgres + app (JVM boot + Flyway) healthy under up --wait

e2e/Run E2E.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 4m48s in one run (6953b44, 113 tests): the Playwright specs alone against a running stack

server/Build and test (Gradle).why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): ten green master ci runs #278-#287 on the final workflow: median 9m53s, range 8m32s-14m24s (the Gradle step alone: compile, detekt, tests at two forks, Kover, installDist)

web/Install dependencies.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): ten green master ci runs #278-#287 on the final workflow: median 8 s, range 7-16 s (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund, cache hit; 7c3642b removed the audit that took 30 s)

e2e-static/Install dependencies.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): ten green master ci runs #278-#287 on the final workflow: median 2 s, range 1-2 s (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund of the e2e workspace)

server-build.why: Re-baselined 2026-11-24 (build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 3): Apple M5 Max, the last ten green gates.sh runs (-Pforks=2, 2026-11-23 and 24, 4b1b0cf..8f51403): median 3m34s, range 3m27s-4m29s, with other gates and agents running beside them; the 1.0.0 figure was 2m05s at -Pforks=1 for 1,109 tests

server-test.why: Unchanged since 2026-11-05 (WHY 1; WHY 3 left it): no recorded series, one run only (2m40s for 1,109 tests); not a gates.sh activity

web-gates.why: Kept at 45 s / 90 s on 2026-11-24 (WHY 3): the last ten green runs (2026-11-15) have median 36 s, range 28-53 s; the rule would loosen it to 60 s / 90 s, and none of the ten breached the alarm

e2e-static.why: Kept at 15 s / 30 s on 2026-11-24 (WHY 3): the last ten green runs (2026-11-14..15) have median 9.0 s, range 7.4-9.7 s; the rule would loosen it to 30 s / 60 s, and none of the ten breached the target

e2e-playwright.why: Unchanged since 2026-11-05 (WHY 1; WHY 3 left it): no recorded series, one run only (2m24s for 123 tests); gates.sh does not run Playwright
